more_info.overview: Sodium potassium tartrate combines sodium and potassium in a salt of tartaric acid, also known as Rochelle salt. Its acidity-regulating role is to adjust or maintain the pH of the food. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-30 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1973). The combined group limit is expressed as L(+)-tartaric acid.
